RocksDB is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2018 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [rocksdb\_indexer](@/work/rocksdb-indexer.md); [bcnode-old](@/work/bcnode-old.md): Mining node with built-in block rover and DHT.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses RocksDB: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links RocksDB to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
